title: Pure Magician Girl

allow.The Gaze of Timaeus: Shared Dark Magician support that works off Dark Magician Girl alone: it shuffles a Dark Magician Girl from the field or GY into the Deck to Fusion Summon the page's 2026 Fusions.
allow.Dark Burning Attack: Shared Dark Magician support that only needs a Dark Magician Girl monster: it destroys every face-up monster the opponent controls.

summary: Pure Magician Girl control and Fusion deck with generic staples. Magician Girls redirect attacks to each other and recover each other from the hand or GY, leveraging Dark Magician Girl and The Gaze of Timaeus into high-impact Dragon Knight and Timaeus Fusions.

summary.title: Starters
points: Berry Magician Girl adds any Magician Girl monster from Deck to hand upon Normal Summon, and Special Summons a Magician Girl from Deck when targeted for an attack or card effect.
Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice discards a card to Special Summon herself from the hand, and treats her name as Dark Magician Girl while face-up or in the GY.
Lemon Magician Girl Tributes a Magician Girl monster (other than herself) to search any Spellcaster monster from the Deck.
Chocolate Magician Girl discards a Spellcaster to draw a card, cycling through your deck.

summary.title: Opening: Berry Magician Girl + The Gaze of Timaeus
steps: Normal Summon Berry Magician Girl to search Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice from the Deck.
Special Summon Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice from hand by discarding a card; her name becomes Dark Magician Girl.
Activate The Gaze of Timaeus, targeting Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice and Berry Magician Girl.
Shuffle both into the Deck to Fusion Summon Timaeus the United Magical Dragon (or Dark Magician Girl the Dragon Knight).
Timaeus enters the field unaffected by other card effects for the turn while Berry Magician Girl is safely back in the Deck for future searches.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Timaeus the United Magical Dragon is unaffected by other cards' effects for the turn it is Fusion Summoned, and destroys opponent Spells/Traps.
Dark Magician Girl the Dragon Knight sends a card from the hand to the GY as a Quick Effect to target and destroy any face-up card on the field.
Quintet Magician destroys every card the opponent controls if Fusion Summoned using five Spellcasters with different names.

Kiwi Magician Girl prevents your Spellcaster monsters from being targeted or destroyed by opponent card effects, and can discard herself to give all Magician Girls a large ATK/DEF pump based on different names in the field and GYs.
Chocolate Magician Girl and Apple Magician Girl punish attacks by reviving or summoning Spellcasters from the GY or hand, redirecting the attack and halving the attacking monster's ATK.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: The Gaze of Timaeus is an allowed Quick-Play Spell that fuses Dark Magician Girl with another Spellcaster from the field or GY by shuffling them back into the Deck.
Dark Burning Attack destroys every face-up monster your opponent controls if you control a Dark Magician Girl monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Magi Magi ☆ Magician Gal is excluded because it has not yet been released in the TCG, and Performapal Sky Magician Girl is omitted as this build runs no Continuous Spells.

exclude.Magi Magi ☆ Magician Gal: Not yet released in the TCG.
